as_told.title: James Bruce seeks the Ark and brings back the Book of Enoch

plain: This story is about James Bruce, a traveller who went to Ethiopia and wrote a book about searching for the source of the Nile. A writer on ancient history, Graham Hancock, says Bruce brought something important back from Ethiopia: the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells the same story in his own words. He calls Bruce a Scottish Freemason, a member of a secretive fraternal society, and says Bruce actually went looking for the Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest from the Bible. Instead, Michels says, he came back with the Book of Enoch, and that is why we have it today. The story matters to them because the Book of Enoch is often read as describing beings who came down to Earth.
